run_train_pipeline: run the PyTorch Lightning training pipeline with Hydra config for model training
resume_training_checkpoint: resume training from the latest checkpoint file or autosave checkpoint
test_model_after_training: test the trained model on the test set after training completes
configure_ddp_strategy: configure DDP strategy automatically when training across multiple GPUs
finalize_training_resources: finalize and clean up training resources including callbacks, loggers, and trainer
